$comment: Hand-written schema for data/prices.json, checked by scripts/avp.mjs validate (no jsonschema package). One object per row. Missing optional fields mean null.

id.doc: Unique, kebab-case, stable across price refreshes.

service.doc: Where you pay: the app or API that bills you, e.g. 'Runway API', 'Luma app', 'UniqAI'.

door.doc: Consumer app with plans/packs, or developer API.

model.doc: Model name as the vendor writes it, e.g. 'Kling 3.0', 'Veo 3.1 Fast'.

maker.doc: Who trained the model (Kuaishou, Google, ByteDance, ...), so resold models can be grouped.

tier.doc: Plan, pack or rate the row is priced on, with its price, e.g. 'Standard plan ($15/mo, 625 credits)'.

plan_price_usd.doc: plan/pack: price of the plan (monthly billing) or pack.

plan_credits.doc: plan/pack: credits included for that price.

price_per_credit_usd.doc: credit_rate: a published dollar price per credit.

credits_per_clip.doc: plan/pack/credit_rate: credits charged for one clip of `seconds`.

credits_per_second.doc: plan/pack/credit_rate: credits charged per second of output (alternative to credits_per_clip).

clip_price_usd.doc: per_clip: published dollar price for one clip of `seconds`.

second_price_usd.doc: per_second: published dollar price per second.

tokens_per_second.doc: per_token: tokens the vendor bills per second of video.

usd_per_1m_tokens.doc: per_token: published price per million tokens.

seconds.doc: Seconds delivered per clip (not requested; UniqAI's '5 s' Veo option delivers 6).

resolution.doc: Output resolution as the vendor labels it (480p, 720p, 768p, 1080p, 2K, 4K).

audio.doc: true when the price includes generated audio; absent when the vendor does not say.

usd_per_second.doc: Computed by `avp recompute --write`, rounded to 3 decimals. Never typed by hand; null for not_published/discontinued rows.

status.doc: not_published: the vendor shows the price only inside an app or console.

approximate.doc: true when the vendor itself writes 'about' or '≈'.

source_label.doc: Short name of the source page.

source_url.doc: The vendor's own pricing page or docs. No third-party roundups.

source_date.doc: Date printed on the source page, when it has one.

checked_on.doc: The day a maintainer last read the source and confirmed the numbers.

notes.doc: Anything a reader needs before comparing this cell with another.

$billing_requires_comment: For published rows: each inner list is a group of which at least one field must be present. credits_per_clip additionally requires seconds.
